_comment: Bundle-size budget for browser consumers and shape-specific imports (issue #145, #494). The dashboard imports the SDK client-side, so this number ships to every operator's browser. The check bundles each declared shape with esbuild (minify, ESM), gzips the result, and fails CI over any limit. On breach: do NOT raise the budget in the same commit as the change that caused it — re-measure, justify the delta in the PR, and commit the new baseline separately.
_headroom: Gzip headroom is 15% of baseline. Raw headroom is 10% of baseline. Raw grows more mechanically than gzip, so it gets less slack.
tool: esbuild (devDependency, already in the tree via tsx) — bundle, minify, format=esm

dashboard.name: dashboard import
dashboard.rationale: Stable dashboard-shaped client import with named exports used by the operator console. Re-baselined after PR #522 added advisory error predicates, streaming WASM verification and rule remediation; measured 964,221 raw / 223,601 gzip on 2026-11-28, 1,847 raw bytes over the previous budget.

root-full.name: root full import
root-full.rationale: Measures the entire public root surface imported together. Ensures the full package size does not grow unchecked.

preflight-interceptor.name: PreFlightInterceptor only
preflight-interceptor.rationale: Consumers importing only PreFlightInterceptor should not pay for telemetry listeners or adapters. Preserves lean agent client weight.

cost-pre-checker.name: CostPreChecker only
cost-pre-checker.rationale: Consumers performing simulation cost pre-checks receive exact-envelope transaction quotes, string fee normalization, and transaction provenance without pulling in the policy engine or telemetry. Budget was remeasured after those additive APIs increased the cost-checker-only import by 24,979 raw bytes and 5,207 gzip bytes.

fs-subpath.name: ./fs subpath (Node-only)
fs-subpath.rationale: Node-only filesystem adapter and policy storage subpath. Bundled with platform=node so node:* imports remain external and are not compared against browser budgets. Re-baselined after the durable JSON cursor store and JSONL event writer added 10,802 raw bytes and 3,547 gzip bytes to this subpath (measured 2026-11-26: 105,832 raw / 28,027 gzip).
